ig_carousel_topic.topic: Why anyone claiming an 80% win rate is lying or selling something
ig_carousel_topic.slide1_text:
Someone just told you they hit 80% of their bets.

That should be your first red flag.
ig_carousel_topic.slide2_text:
The assumption: a sharp bettor wins most of the time.

Most people believe a good handicapper should be right 7 or 8 times out of 10. It feels logical. It's wrong.
ig_carousel_topic.slide3_text:
The honest math: the best bettors in the world hit 55 to 58 percent.

Sportsbooks set lines to be 50/50. Beating that by 5 points consistently is what separates professionals from gamblers. 80% is not a real number.
ig_carousel_topic.slide4_text:
A 55% win rate at -110 juice, betting 1 unit per game across 500 plays:

Profit: roughly +22 units.
An 80% claimant would need to go 400-100. No tracked, audited service has ever done that at scale.
ig_carousel_topic.slide5_text:
The target is 53 to 58 percent, not 80.

Anyone showing you a screenshot of 12 wins in a row is showing you 12 picks out of hundreds. Ask for the full ledger. If they don't have one, that's the answer.
